answer: Price each identity by the exhaust it leaves: a farm paying one operator must concentrate its coin inflow, so trace where each new address got its first spark. Track the funding ancestors of every claim and score how much distinct garden-variety inflow sits behind it. A bridge of unrelated funders, like branches feeding a working river, signals autonomy; a single spring feeding forty masks drains the tide of trust. Timber-strong wallets earn full emission, cloned ones get a thin drip.
